identification: Modern reproduction Prussian-style pickelhaube (officer-pattern look): glossy brush-painted black shell, pressed brass Prussian eagle 'FR' plate, plain round spike base with four studs and fluted spike, brass front and rear visor trim, leather chinstrap on brass side posts with Reich (black/white/red) and Prussian (black/white) cockades. Interior: clean black leather liner with tan-backed tongues, brass spike nut, no maker, unit, depot or date stamps visible. Construction and finish match the Indian-made replicas sold new on eBay, not a WW1 original.

viewing_check: Lift the liner tongues and look for depot/maker stamps and a year inside the crown and on the visor undersides; check whether the shell is real hardened leather (cracking, stitching at the rear spine) or painted pressed material; magnet on fittings. Only bid if real stamps appear.
rate_note: Database prices are AUD hammer, rate 1. Reproduction-described Noble lots (2017) hammered $220-340; originals $270-1,000. Blind view: likely reproduction, realistic range roughly $60-150 unless stamps show it is original.
